result.brief: 在统一世界-动作模型框架下系统研究第一人称人类数据的对齐、任务多样性与监督方式对机器人学习的影响，并验证视频监督的有效性。
result.reason: Studies egocentric human data scaling within a unified world-action model framework, disentangling alignment, supervision and usage strategies for robot learning; directly informs embodied world models and video-action training.
